test.fill_query: SELECT throwIf(count() != 100000000 OR countIf(CounterID = 1629) != 696473 OR countIf(CounterID = 0 OR CounterID >= 1000000000) != 0) FROM hits_100m_single

INSERT INTO FUNCTION url(concat('http://127.0.0.1:', toString(getServerPort('http_port')), '/?max_query_size=16777216&framing_output_format=JSONEachPacketString&wait_end_of_query=1&log_comment=analyzer_large_queries.in_int'), 'RawBLOB', 'q String') SELECT concat('SELECT count() FROM hits_100m_single WHERE CounterID IN (1629,', arrayStringConcat(range(1000000000, 1000199999), ','), '\n)')

INSERT INTO FUNCTION url(concat('http://127.0.0.1:', toString(getServerPort('http_port')), '/?max_query_size=16777216&framing_output_format=JSONEachPacketString&wait_end_of_query=1&log_comment=analyzer_large_queries.in_string'), 'RawBLOB', 'q String') SELECT concat('SELECT count() FROM hits_100m_single WHERE CounterID = 0 AND URL IN (', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('\'http://example.com/catalog/item-', toString(i), '.html\''), range(1, 200001)), ','), ')')

INSERT INTO FUNCTION url(concat('http://127.0.0.1:', toString(getServerPort('http_port')), '/?max_parser_depth=10000&max_subquery_depth=1000&query_plan_max_optimizations_to_apply=0&framing_output_format=JSONEachPacketString&wait_end_of_query=1&log_comment=analyzer_large_queries.nested'), 'RawBLOB', 'q String') SELECT concat('SELECT sum(c100) FROM (', arrayFold((acc, i) -> concat('SELECT *, c', toString(i - 1), ' + 1 AS c', toString(i), ' FROM (', acc, ') WHERE c', toString(i - 1), ' != ', toString(i)), range(1, 101), 'SELECT *, WatchID AS c0 FROM hits_100m_single'), ') WHERE CounterID = 0')

INSERT INTO FUNCTION url(concat('http://127.0.0.1:', toString(getServerPort('http_port')), '/?framing_output_format=JSONEachPacketString&wait_end_of_query=1&log_comment=analyzer_large_queries.ctes'), 'RawBLOB', 'q String') SELECT concat('WITH ', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('m', toString(i), ' AS (SELECT count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single WHERE CounterID = 0 AND RegionID = ', toString(i), ')'), range(1, 401)), ', '), ' SELECT sum(c) FROM (', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('SELECT c FROM m', toString(i)), range(1, 401)), ' UNION ALL '), ')')

SELECT throwIf(uniqExact(log_comment) != 4 OR count() != 4 OR countIf(read_rows > if(log_comment = 'analyzer_large_queries.in_int', 704512, 0)) != 0 OR countIf(ProfileEvents['QueryParseMicroseconds'] + ProfileEvents['QueryAnalysisMicroseconds'] + ProfileEvents['QueryPlanBuildMicroseconds'] + ProfileEvents['QueryPlanOptimizeMicroseconds'] + ProfileEvents['QueryPipelineBuildMicroseconds'] < query_duration_ms * 500) != 0, 'a generated query is missing in query_log, read too many rows or spent less than half of its time in planning') FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND log_comment IN ('analyzer_large_queries.in_int', 'analyzer_large_queries.in_string', 'analyzer_large_queries.nested', 'analyzer_large_queries.ctes') AND event_time_microseconds > (SELECT max(event_time_microseconds) FROM system.query_log WHERE log_comment = 'analyzer_large_queries.start')
test.query: test "$({ printf 'SELECT count() FROM hits_100m_single WHERE CounterID IN (1629,'; seq -s, 1000000000 1000199998; printf ')'; } | ${CLICKHOUSE_CURL} "${CLICKHOUSE_URL}?max_query_size=16777216" --data-binary @-)" = 696473

test "$({ printf "SELECT count() FROM hits_100m_single WHERE CounterID = 0 AND URL IN ('http://example.com/catalog/item-"; seq -s ".html','http://example.com/catalog/item-" 200000 | tr -d '\n'; printf ".html')"; } | ${CLICKHOUSE_CURL} "${CLICKHOUSE_URL}?max_query_size=16777216" --data-binary @-)" = 0

q='SELECT *, WatchID AS c0 FROM hits_100m_single' for i in $(seq 100); do q="SELECT *, c$((i - 1)) + 1 AS c$i FROM ($q) WHERE c$((i - 1)) != $i"; done test "$(printf 'SELECT sum(c100) FROM (%s) WHERE CounterID = 0' "$q" | ${CLICKHOUSE_CURL} "${CLICKHOUSE_URL}?max_parser_depth=10000&max_subquery_depth=1000&query_plan_max_optimizations_to_apply=0" --data-binary @-)" = 0

printf -v w 'm%d AS (SELECT count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single WHERE CounterID = 0 AND RegionID = %d), ' $(seq 400 | sed 's/.*/& &/') printf -v u 'SELECT c FROM m%d UNION ALL ' $(seq 400) test "$(printf 'WITH %s SELECT sum(c) FROM (%s)' "${w%, }" "${u% UNION ALL }" | ${CLICKHOUSE_CURL} "${CLICKHOUSE_URL}" --data-binary @-)" = 0
